Use case: scientific-educational. Create one finished STATIC editorial mechanism illustration for a serious technical news article, wide 1200x630 composition. This is conceptual explanatory artwork, not an engineering schematic or measured plot.
Subject: Business-grounded agent evaluation spans design, release gates and production feedback; uptime alone does not detect factual errors.
Composition: Three-zone continuous evaluation ribbon with a magnified evaluation stack. A compact threshold rail shows Safety / Quality / Latency / Cost feeding the release gate. Show clear left-to-right progression and a single return feedback ribbon to Golden sets. No implication that live adversarial checks occur only once. The loop is conceptual.

NO other writing, numbers, pseudo-text or title. Type bold clean dark sans serif, readable at final size, at least about 19px. Pair labels with meaningful physicalized conceptual components, not a wall of boxed text. Crisp textbook illustration, subtle dimensional layering, exceptionally clean geometry and clear arrowheads. Navy, teal and amber accents on white. 12+ grounded components, useful occupancy80–90%, 36px safe margins all sides, generous clear label spacing. Use deliberate visual hierarchy, two visible internal substages in the central gate machinery, two evidence/feedback relationships. No people, faces, humanoids, robots, logos, brands, photorealism, dashboard panels, watermarks, filler or unsupported numbers. No claim that uptime proves accuracy. No guarantee that checks eliminate failures. No invented performance statistics.
